# Discount Code

`promotional/discount-code` &middot; content-level &middot; category: promotional

## Purpose

A boxed discount code with a label and optional expiry. The code can be fixed or a Klaviyo unique-coupon tag.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | text | `"Use code at checkout"` |
| `expires` | text |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Dashed accent box, transparent inside.
- **solid**: A solid accent-colored box with white text. Sets `background: @colors.accent`, `color: @colors.white`, `labelColor: @colors.white`, `borderStyle: solid`.
- **on-color**: White dashed box for use on colored bands. Sets `color: @colors.white`, `labelColor: @colors.white`, `borderColor: @colors.white`.
- **plain**: Just the code, no border. Sets `borderStyle: none`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `color` | color | `"@colors.accent"` |
| `labelColor` | color | `"@colors.mutedText"` |
| `background` | color | `"transparent"` |
| `borderColor` | color | `"@colors.accent"` |
| `borderWidth` | length | `"2px"` |
| `borderStyle` | one of `dashed`, `solid`, `dotted`, `none` | `"dashed"` |
| `radius` | length | `"@radius.medium"` |
| `size` | length | `"28px"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.sm 0"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Box and text honored. Dashed can render solid, rounded corners square. | Fine. The code is real text and can be copied. | Keeps its own colors. Use on-color on colored bands. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('promotional/discount-code', {
  "code": "SUMMER25",
  "label": "Use code at checkout",
  "expires": "Expires 30 June"
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "promotional/discount-code",
  "data": {
    "code": "SUMMER25",
    "label": "Use code at checkout",
    "expires": "Expires 30 June"
  }
}
```
